description: Look up SwiftProbate's published probate guide for a specific US county: verified courthouse address/phone/website, filing fee, approved newspapers for publication, e-filing system, and county-specific probate forms. Use this before answering any question about a county court's contact info, filing fees, or publication requirements — county-level details are unreliable from model knowledge alone.

county.description: County name, e.g. 'Alameda' or 'Alameda County' (either works).

state.description: Two-letter code ('CA'), full name ('California'), or slug ('california').

name: lookup_county_guide
